messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — Redwood is doing a joint launch with CloudAtlas for the Edge Connector. Scope: Cloud listing, a short benchmark blog, and a 45-min intro webinar. Need a clear ops checklist + inbound lead routing plan. Who can take pieces?
Samira (Growth): I can run webinar production + landing page copy. Proposed webinar date: Apr 10 (US-friendly). Does that block anyone?
Ben (Demand): Apr 10 is fine if listing is live by Apr 3 and benchmark post by Apr 8. Ops: we need marketplace leads flowing to SFDC w/ source=cloudatlas.
Devon (Sales): Sales queue to use: marketplace-inbound. SDR: Jason will own follow-up. We need sample webhook payload so we can map fields to SFDC lead.owner and lead.source.
Arjun (Product): I’ll own the demo + benchmark numbers. Plan to publish 3 graphs: p99 latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, and end-to-end cold/hot start. I’ll post run commands and raw numbers by EOD Wed.
Integrations Bot: Marketplace listing status: draft -> awaiting partner review (https://cloudatlas.example/review/edge-connector).
Maya (Marketing): Good — Samira, can you confirm landing page CTA and form fields? Also we want UTM params: utm_source=cloudatlas&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=edge-launch.
Samira (Growth): Landing CTA: "Try Redwood Edge Connector — free trial + demo". Form fields: name, email, company, region, interest-level. Form mapping to Segment/SFDC:
```json
{
  "email": "email",
  "first_name": "name",
  "company": "company",
  "region": "region",
  "interest": "custom_01",
  "source": "cloudatlas",
  "utm": "{{utm_params}}"
}
```
Ben (Demand): For routing: marketplace webhook -> Segment track -> our inbound lambda -> SFDC. Lambda should set Lead.Owner = "marketplace-inbound" and Lead.RecordType = "Marketplace". Also add tag: marketplace:cloudatlas.
Devon (Sales): Received. Jason prefers leads with company size > 50 flagged. Can we add a small enrichment step?
Arjun (Product): We can run a quick enrichment via Clearbit in the lambda; add field employee_count. We'll set threshold in payload mapping.
Maya (Marketing): Draft of benchmark narrative snippet for blog (short): "Redwood Edge Connector reduces p99 latency by up to 40% for 2k token sequences versus baseline, while cutting inference unit cost by ~30% via batching + prefix caching." Need edits.
Samira (Growth): Love the angle. Add a short customer-facing line: "deployable in your VPC or via our hosted API — same SLA, lower cost."
Ben (Demand): CTA sequences for webinar: (1) listing -> sign-up (2) sign-up -> confirmation email with recording link (3) webinar -> benchmark blog + product trial. We'll need emails and UTM-tracked links.
Maya (Marketing): Who will create the confirmation email copy? Samira? Also we need speaker list: Arjun (product), Maya (marketing), and one customer (TBD). Samira, can you own speaker outreach?
Samira (Growth): On it. I'll ping the customer and handle logistics.
Devon (Sales): Action item: provide SDR playbook for marketplace leads (what to say, timeline). I'll draft and drop in the repo by Thu.
Arjun (Product): Demo script (short): 1) Install connector, 2) 30s cold invocation, 3) show p99 improvement with batching on 2k token prompt, 4) cost calc. Will post script + commands:
```bash
# run benchmark on test cluster
python run_bench.py --model=redwood-edge --seq=2048 --concurrency=4 --runs=100
```
Maya (Marketing): Ops checklist — initial draft: 
- Marketplace listing: partner review (Ben) — due Apr 1
- Listing go-live (Integrations Bot) — target Apr 3
- Benchmark blog draft (Arjun) — due Apr 5
- Blog review (Marketing + Legal) — due Apr 7
- Webinar landing page + form (Samira) — live Apr 3
- Webinar production & invites (Samira) — invites out by Apr 1
- Lead routing lambda + enrichment (Ben/Eng) — deployed Apr 2
- SDR playbook (Devon) — done Apr 4
- Post-webinar recording + blog amplification (Marketing) — Apr 11
Maya (Marketing): Final ask — everyone drop a one-line confirmation below with the item you own + ✅ when you accept. I'll compile into Notion and tag the calendar.
Ben (Demand): Accepting: listing partner review + routing sign-off ✅
Samira (Growth): Accepting: landing page, webinar ops, speaker outreach ✅
Arjun (Product): Accepting: benchmark data + demo script + slides ✅
Devon (Sales): Accepting: SDR playbook + lead triage rules ✅
Integrations Bot: Reminder scheduled: checklist reminder posted Apr 2 09:00 UTC.
